top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Little Apple 100's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
Little Apple 100's Illinois farmland gravel, State championship forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 62 miles.
Little Apple 100's Illinois farmland gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on Illinois farmland gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
62 miles on Illinois farmland gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
At Little Apple 100, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Little Apple 100. Train it until it feels boring.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Little Apple 100, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on Illinois farmland gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Varied gradients on Illinois farmland gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,000ft of climbing on Illinois farmland gravel does to your power file on race day.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Little Apple 100’s 62 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Little Apple 100 requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on illinois farmland gravel to build confidence. Expect: illinois farmland gravel, state championship, flat fast century-k.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Gravel Specific, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 62 miles of illinois farmland gravel in Manhattan, Illinois.
